results.content: *[Screenwriter takes long drag from PCP-laced future-cigarette]* Right, so: in 2024, the government’s going to forget everything we learned from *A Clockwork Orange* and Ludovico everybody except cops out of all bad impulses via processor chips in our brains, which means this guy — oh man, what if he was seriously named Graham Bricke, and everyone just kept referring to him as “Brick” — he has one week to steal a billion dollars from a “money factory” (you know, like, the place where they print money, whatever) before the forced pacifism brain-signal goes live, but he starts sleeping with the fiancée of the guy he’s working with — that guy’s rich, so his name should be Cash, as in money — and so there’s some double-crossing in there, except that first they need to counterfeit a bunch of money and trick the government into buying it *from* them, all of which they carry out in the most joylessly hyperviolent manner conceivable.
